trip.name: Tour du Mont Blanc
trip.startDateNote: This is the arrival day, the first entry in the itinerary — not the first day of walking. Arriving Fri Jul 2 2027 puts hiking day 1 on Sat Jul 3, the Courmayeur rest day on Tue Jul 6, and the last hiking day on Fri Jul 9. Set from the booked hotel nights, which are the group's confirmed record.
trip.notes: 6 hiking days plus one rest day in Courmayeur, then two nights back in Chamonix. Shuttles cover the sections we are skipping, and two nights sleep off the trail — see docs/transit-notes.md.

money.budgetNote: Food, shuttles and hotels on-trail. Excludes Chamonix nights before and after, and flights.

sync.endpointNote: Cloudflare Worker that appends shared edits to the op log. Empty means sync is off, and pages fall back to queueing edits on the device. Set this once for the group; each person still enters the passphrase on their own device. See docs/sync-setup.md.
